title: Normalize Target Schema Interface Field Groups
description: Normalize compose/graphql/target.schema.graphql so inherited fields are grouped under the interface that actually defines them. For example, WeakEntity/StrongEntity implementors should use # Node for id and # Entity for hash/owner/owns, and concrete Artifact/Diff/Modification/Modifications/Operation shapes should split inherited fields into the correct interface groups instead of lumping them under # WeakEntity or # StrongEntity. Validate the schema still parses after the comment-only cleanup.
summary: Normalized compose/graphql/target.schema.graphql inherited field-group comments so fields now sit under the interface that actually defines them: Node for id, Entity for hash/owner/owns, RichStrongEntity vs Artifact splits for artifact hierarchies, and concrete Modifications/Operation markers where entity-specific fields begin. Verified no legacy # WeakEntity/# StrongEntity group markers remain in the schema and validated SDL parsing with graphql buildSchema.
